# Semantic Portable Document Format 0.1 RC1

SPD is a semantic portable-document format designed so humans and software or AI agents can safely address, edit, and reason about persistent document objects. Format 0.1 RC1 is experimental and is being released for external review.

Format 0.1 deliberately keeps EPUB 3.3 as its publication and packaging baseline. SPD does not introduce a new container, HTML replacement, or layout stack. It adds persistent document, revision, and node identity; transaction-safe editing semantics; integrity and lifecycle state; optional semantic-to-fixed mapping; revision-aware annotations; and a passive-content security profile.

## RC1 validation

- 118 requirements
- 107 conformance fixtures
- Validator A ↔ Validator B: 107/107 exact agreement
- Validator A ↔ reviewed oracle: 107/107
- Validator B ↔ reviewed oracle: 107/107
- official EPUBCheck 5.3.0 executed on 107/107 package byte sequences in each validator
- 48/48 Base-PASS fixtures pass EPUBCheck in both validators
- zero new specification blockers
- no normative semantic changes from the converged pre-RC Draft

## Review scope and limitations

Fixed-Experimental and Archive-Experimental remain experimental. Reader behavior, manual accessibility evaluation, digital signatures, encryption/DRM, functional forms, interactive or scripting capabilities, collaboration and tracked changes, and a final agent API are deferred or outside the RC1 validation claim. RC1 is not a finalized standard, a W3C standard, a PDF replacement, or a claim of universal security.

External review is explicitly requested, especially for specification ambiguities, independent implementation experience, security and accessibility issues, EPUB interoperability, and the mapping and identity models.
